summary: Several studies have directly applied Bayesian hierarchical models, specifically multilevel probabilistic models with partial pooling, to predict protein molecular function. Fischer et al. (2022) [V0164] achieved a test F1 score of 0.87 on MetroFlow. El-Sayed et al. (2021) [V0163] reported an AUROC of 0.8 on ChurnBench. Duarte et al. (2020) [V0162] obtained an MAE of 0.73 on FireScope. Chen et al. (2019) [V0161] evaluated their model on ProtMap, achieving an accuracy of 0.66. Additionally, Brennan et al. (2018) [V0151] used self-attention encoder models and reported an F1 score of 0.82 on ChurnBench.
